problem_text: Prove that there is a constant c > 0 with the following property: If a, b, n are positive integers such that gcd(a + i, b + j) > 1 for all i, j in {0, 1, ..., n}, then min{a, b} > (cn)^n.
solution_text: Take c = 1/65536. Split into small n (n < 2^15, trivial: min{a,b} >= 2 > (n/65536)^n) and large n (n >= 2^15). For large n: set M = n^2/1000, N = n+1. Consider the N x N grid of pairs (a+i, b+j), each with gcd > 1. Define 'small cells' S = cells where some prime p <= M divides both a+i and b+j. Sieve counting gives |S| <= sum_{p<=M} (N/p+1)^2 = N^2 * sum(1/p^2) + 2N * sum(1/p) + |P|. Using sum(1/p^2) <= 47/100, sum(1/p) <= clog_2(M+1) <= n/100, |P| <= M < N^2/100, we get |S| < N^2/2. So > N^2/2 cells are 'big' (only large prime divisors > M). By pigeonhole, some row i_0 has > N/2 big cells. For each big cell j in row i_0, a large prime q_j > M divides both a+i_0 and b+j. Injection: if q_{j1} = q_{j2} then q | (j2-j1) but |j2-j1| < n < q, contradiction. So these primes are distinct, giving a+i_0 >= (M+1)^{#big cells} >= (n^2/1000)^{(n+3)/2}. The numerical inequality (n^2/1000)^{(n+3)/2} > (n/65536)^n + n holds for n >= 2^15. Symmetric argument for b. Hence min{a,b} > (n/65536)^n = (cn)^n.
solution_summary: 取c=1/65536。将(n+1)x(n+1)网格中每格的共同素因子按阈值M=n^2/1000分为大小两类，筛法证明小素数覆盖<N^2/2格，鸽巢提取一行>N/2个大素数格，注入论证证明大素数互异，乘积迫使a+i_0>=(n^2/1000)^((n+3)/2)>(n/65536)^n。
answer: There exists c > 0 (specifically c = 1/65536) such that if gcd(a+i, b+j) > 1 for all i,j in {0,...,n}, then min{a,b} > (cn)^n.
structure_features: (n+1)x(n+1) grid of gcd conditions, sieve counting with prime size threshold, pigeonhole row extraction, injection for distinctness, product bound, numerical inequality comparison
key_insight: Split common prime factors in the grid by size threshold n^2/1000; sieve counting shows small primes cover less than half the cells; pigeonhole extracts a row with many large-prime cells; injection proves these large primes are distinct; their product forces a+i_0 to be huge.
translation_to: combinatorial counting language (sieve counting of prime coverage on grid)

bare_ai_error_prediction: Bare AI会尝试直接操作gcd条件或对n归纳，看不到从gcd网格到筛法计数的翻译。即使考虑到网格，也会在阈值校准（M=n^2/1000的选择需要同时满足筛法界和最终指数比较）和注入论证（利用q>n>|j2-j1|证明大素数互异）上卡住。

rounds.question: 描述这道题的结构：已知条件是什么？要证明什么？常数c的角色是什么？
rounds.expected_answer: 题目要求证明存在c>0使得：若对所有i,j∈{0,...,n}有gcd(a+i,b+j)>1，则min{a,b}>(cn)^n。c是一个不依赖于a,b,n的绝对常数。核心是从gcd网格条件推出a,b的下界。

rounds.question: 列出所有可能的方法来证明min{a,b}的下界：归纳法、直接gcd操作、计数论证、筛法、概率论证等
rounds.expected_answer: 可能方法：1)对n归纳 2)直接从gcd条件提取信息 3)考虑(n+1)x(n+1)网格中每格的共同素因子 4)筛法计数 5)用中国剩余定理构造 6)概率/密度论证

rounds.question: 试试直接方法：能否对n归纳？或直接从gcd(a,b)>1推出min{a,b}的下界？
rounds.expected_answer: 直接归纳困难：从n到n+1需要控制新增的gcd条件。直接从gcd(a,b)>1只能得min>=2，远不够。条件是(n+1)^2个gcd同时>1，信息量很大但直接提取困难。

rounds.question: 重新框定问题：考虑(n+1)x(n+1)网格，每格(a+i,b+j)都有一个共同素因子。思考哪些素数能覆盖很多格？
rounds.expected_answer: 每格有一个共同素因子p。小素数p能覆盖约(N/p)^2个格（因为p|a+i约N/p个i，p|b+j约N/p个j）。大素数覆盖的格少。关键是：如果小素数覆盖不了所有格，剩余格必须用大素数，而大素数迫使a+i很大。

rounds.question: 将素数分为小(<=M=n^2/1000)和大(>M)。用筛法界证明小素数覆盖的格|S|<N^2/2。需要哪些求和界？
小素数格<半，故>半是大格。用鸽巢找到某行i_0有>N/2个大格。证明这些大格的大素数互异，并推出乘积界。
rounds.expected_answer: 鸽巢：N行中某行有>N/2个大格。对行i_0的每个大格j，取大素数q_j>M整除a+i_0和b+j。注入：若q_{j1}=q_{j2}=q，则q|(b+j1)且q|(b+j2)，故q|(j2-j1)，但|j2-j1|<n<q（因q>M>=n），矛盾。故互异。a+i_0>=prod(q_j)>=(M+1)^{#大格}>=(n^2/1000)^{(n+3)/2}。

analysis_metadata.notes: USA 2014 P6 - 筛法计数+鸽巢+注入论证的经典数论竞赛题。核心难点是将gcd网格条件翻译为素数覆盖计数问题。阈值M=n^2/1000的校准是implicit型tell。
